raw_response:
This plot is small, only 0.08 hectares, and I am growing beans. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I do not need much chemical fertilizer — maybe just a small bit of DAP at planting for the phosphorus, but urea is not worth it for legumes. I will put some manure from my cattle since I have it at home, and I will use my own seed saved from last season because improved bean seed is hard to find and costly here. I cannot irrigate — I depend on the meher rains — and for such a small plot my wife and I can handle the work ourselves without hiring anyone.
